title: light up pumpkin
text: light up pumpkin. Ordered the biggest pumpkin with our family name... I placed on the hearth near our electric insert - but not near enough for any heat.  It is very large and quite pretty.  Looks more expensive that it was in my personal opinion.  You'll need 3 AA batteries - has a timer switch or an "on" position or "off."  Timer is 6 hours on, 18 hours off I believe.  The pumpkin is a good shape - natural-ish orange color with a curved green stem.  It is resin or like material.  It's weighty - but not too heavy.  With good care and storage, it looks like it will last for years. For being a personalized item it came very quickly too.  Having said all of that,  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Let's Make Memories Personalized Light Up Pumpkin - Family Name Jack-O-Lantern Halloween Décor - Your Name & Initial on a Custom Pumpkin - Fall - Light Up Indoors/Outdoors - Large - Orange
features: LIGHT UP FALL CELEBRATIONS: Ripe with seasonal charm, this stunning pumpkin will light up all your indoor/outdoor fall celebrations—including Halloween. Keep your home aglow with this sophisticated take on the traditional jack-o-lantern.

PERFECTLY PERSONALIZED: Choose orange (pictured), silver glitter, cream or gold glitter. Elegantly personalize your pumpkin with any name up to 12 characters and any single initial in beautiful script.

CONVENIENT TIMER. Extend battery life with a 3-way switch and 6-hour timer. Turn pumpkin on at dusk, then sleep soundly knowing it will automatically turn off in 6 hours. Small uses 3 AAA batteries, Large and XL use 3 AA batteries (not included).

PREMIUM QUALITY: Made of durable, weather-resistant resin with built-in yellow LED lights and waterproof battery compartment: Large (9”Hx7.5” dia.) (pictured), Small (7”Hx5.5” dia.), XL (12.5”Hx10.5” dia.). Imported for final manufacture locally.

A GIFT TO FALL FOR: A Halloween decoration with style! Designed for indoor/outdoor use, friends and family will love displaying their pumpkin throughout autumn. Or add a touch of seasonal fun to a classroom, fall festival or dorm room.
